ENGINEERING EXPERIENCE

From instrument to interface

As the sole developer at Peak HydroMet Solutions, I work directly with clients and build across the stack. One project starts with a Davis weather station’s binary protocol and ends with readable measurements on a dashboard.

I wrote the embedded bridge in C++, built multithreaded Python data processing, and customized ThingsBoard charts and Leaflet maps. For anomaly detection, I combined historical readings with temporal, nearby-station, and geospatial features.
